privacy.title: Privacy
body: NightLife Trivia keeps only what the game needs: your nickname, your team and its answers, and a random session cookie so this phone stays signed in. There are no accounts or passwords.
If you sign up for the newsletter, we keep your email address and when you agreed. Staff can export the list to send NightLife news, and nothing else.
Prize codes are linked to your nickname so staff can hand them over. Feedback ratings are kept to improve the game.
privacy.deleteBody: This removes your nickname, team memberships, prize codes and newsletter sign-up from this game. Team scores stay, without your name.
privacy.notJoined: This phone has no data to delete.
